page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.4xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized instance from the Enhanced family, designed for compute-intensive workloads that require dedicated processing capacity and solid networking throughput. It is powered by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor, offering 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core under KVM virtualization. The instance includes 32.0 GB of system memory, matching a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio. It features dedicated CPU resource allocation with hardware instructions including AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and cryptographic accelerations like VAES and SHA-NI.

The server does not include local disk storage or hardware GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached block storage for persistent data needs. In exchange, it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. Benchmark results place the instance consistently in the middle tier of comparable cloud hardware, achieving a Geekbench single-core score of 1521.0, a multi-core score of 9288.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 20950.43. Memory bandwidth delivers 99.38 GB/sec on large-block read operations and 56.5 GB/sec on large writes, supporting steady throughput across concurrent tasks.

From an architectural standpoint, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM allocation optimizes resource expenditure by avoiding excess memory capacity for CPU-bound applications. The absence of bundled local storage minimizes baseline overhead for stateless systems, although teams must factor in networked storage latency for I/O-intensive pipelines. The instance is suited for batch processing, web serving, software build pipelines, and mid-tier compute tasks that benefit from dedicated CPU cores and high network bandwidth.
